headline: Virtual boy group WINKX debut with 'HALO' Nov 27
sub: Ex-SM CEO Han Se-min's Titan Contents launches its first virtual act
source: Source: WINKX debut showcase, via Korean media
caption:
Meet WINKX, a new four-member virtual boy group set to debut with the digital single 'HALO' on November 27 at 6 PM KST.

They held their debut showcase in Seoul on November 25. Titan Contents, led by former SM Entertainment CEO Han Se-min, said it worked to set WINKX apart from PLAVE. Member Mir compared the group's charm to Pyongyang naengmyeon: subtle at first, then hard to stop.

📌 Source: WINKX debut showcase, via Korean media (Etoday, Hankyung)
